days.title: Light
days.detail: The deep is unformed. Speak light into it.
days.evening: Evening came, and morning — the first day.

days.title: Waters
days.detail: Divide the waters. Let a sea, a river, and a lake take their places.
days.evening: Evening came, and morning — the second day.

days.title: Dry land
days.detail: Call the dry land up out of the dark, and let a garden floor appear.
days.evening: Evening came, and morning — the third day.

days.title: Seed
days.detail: Bring forth grass and trees. Set the Tree of Life and the Tree of Knowledge in the midst.
days.evening: The ground answered. Fruit took its color.

days.title: Luminaries
days.detail: Set a greater light and a lesser light, so the garden can tell its hours.
days.evening: Evening came, and morning — the fourth day.

days.title: Living creatures
days.detail: Fill the water, the air, and the grass with living things.
days.evening: The garden began to move of its own accord.

days.title: Humanity
days.detail: Form a man, speak with him, and then form his companion.
days.evening: Two breaths moved in the garden, and neither was alone.

days.title: Rest
days.detail: Descend and draw near to each of them beneath the trees.
days.evening: You rested, and the work did not unwind.
